name: Witch Knight (Eldritch Knight)
body:
Witch knights are templars who have been trained in the arcane arts by secret masters and know how to appeal to witch patrons for their spells.

Requirements

To qualify to become a witch knight, a character must fulfill all the following criteria.

Spellcasting Able to cast 3rd-level arcane spells.
Weapon Proficiency: Must be proficient with all martial weapons.
Special: Patron and hex class features.

This alters requirements.

Bonus Feats

A witch knight adds Extra Hex to the bonus feats he can select from eldritch knight level advancement. This alters bonus feats.

Diverse Training

A witch knight adds his level to any levels of fighter he might have for the purpose of meeting the prerequisites for feats (if he has no fighter levels, treat his eldritch knight levels as levels of fighter). He also adds his level to any levels in an arcane spellcasting class for the purpose of meeting the prerequisites for feats, using and qualifying for hexes, and gaining patron spells. This alters diverse training.
